newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brierley says Fairfax stake long term.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brierley says Fairfax stake long term.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd executive director Rodney Price told shareholders of John Fairfax Holdings Ltd on Friday that Brierley intended to be a long term holder of its 20 percent stake in the newspaper company.
"Our objective is to be a long term shareholder of this company," Price told a meeting of Fairfax shareholders called to decide whether Brierley could increase its stake to 25 percent.

"That's where we started many many months ago, and that's where it is now," he said, referring to the long term commitment. However, Price said he could not give a cast iron guarantee that Brierley would hold the stake forever.
